# District Car — Jharkhand Tours & Travels Mobility System
> District Car is Jharkhand's premier app-based mobility network and outstation travel provider. We connect Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad, Bokaro, Deoghar, Latehar, Khunti, and Ramgarh with verified chauffeurs, transparent fixed pricing, and round-trip sightseeing packages.

## Core Links & Applications
- Customer Mobile App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.districtcarcustomerd.app
- Driver Partner App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.drivercardistrict.app
- Official Website: https://districtcar.in/

## Vehicle Categories & Inclusions
- Economy Mini (Alto, WagonR): 4 Seats, Boot space for 2 bags, AC, ideal for budget day trips.
- Prime Sedan AC (Dzire, Etios, Amaze): 4 Seats, Spacious legroom, large trunk, ideal for families.
- Heavy-Duty SUV (Ertiga, Innova, Bolero Neo): 6-7 Seats, superior ground clearance for ghats and forest routes.
- All round-trip bookings include dedicated driver waiting time (3 to 5 hours), doorstep pickup, and no surge pricing.
